text: I have recently been contacted by business owners on Eastern Avenue requesting that we investigate adding Pay and Display parking to increase parking options outside of the posted rush-hour restrictions. I am asking your support to investigate whether it is worth pursuing the adding of Pay and Display on this small stretch of Eastern.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Requested Transportation Services to investigate and report back on options to add Pay and Display Parking on the South Side of Eastern Avenue, between the Rail Corridor and Sunlight Park Boulevard.
